scenes.text: Claude built a commission calculator with a what-if screen. Cy types in a twenty-five thousand dollar deal. It adds three thousand six hundred and fifty dollars: two thousand at ten percent, twenty-three thousand at fifteen. Nothing is saved.
Then the gap. The what-if split could mean either rep's share. Does Cy keep twenty percent, or does Rosa get it? Now it matches the split on a real deal. All ten gaps are fixed.
What we didn't test: real sign-in, two people saving at once, importing the export into a real payroll system, and hosting. Check those before your team relies on it.
